principle: Do not treat coefficient, structural, route-exact, bitstring-exhaustive, and Aer validation as one scaling problem.

layers.name: analytical coefficient
layers.policy: Generate QUBO from equations and compare coefficient structure, signs, index coverage, and hashes.

layers.name: structural one-hot
layers.policy: Check row/column exact-one structure and penalty construction analytically.

layers.name: targeted exhaustive
layers.policy: Exhaustively validate small substructures or selected variable subsets only.

layers.name: known feasible route
layers.policy: Encode known permutations; require zero constraint penalty and objective equality.

layers.name: known invalid states
layers.policy: Construct duplicate-customer, missing-customer, and duplicate-position states; require positive penalty.

layers.name: fixed-seed sampled
layers.policy: Sample bitstrings with a recorded seed and report coverage/uncertainty; never call it exhaustive.

layers.name: exact route reference
layers.policy: Continue n! route enumeration for exact optimum where route costs are available.

full_bitstring_policy: Required for baseline n<=4 only; not required for n>=5 unless separately justified by a resource preflight and scientific question.
important_semantics: Exact P_feasible/P_optimal from full-state probabilities must not be conflated with sampled estimates.
